metadata.title: Gale crater / expanded HiRISE strip
metadata.resampling: Exact stride-77 sampling of archived float32 heights. No interpolation, stretching or filling. Fine features may alias.
metadata.caveat: The continuous valid source strip is about 4.05 by 9.97 km, not a 10 by 10 km square. The display step does not resolve wheel-scale obstacles.
metadata.projection: EQUIRECTANGULAR planetocentric east-positive, center lat=0 lon=137.3, radius=3396190m
